title: %discount — present value of a future amount
purpose: Discount a future value back to today: FV / (1 + r)^n.
notes: Discounting is the inverse of %compound; the future value of 10000 at 5% for 10 years discounts back to 10000.
The rate is a per-period fraction: 5% is 0.05, not 5.

avoid.why: %discount needs futureValue, rate, and periods; fewer than three arguments yields ~ (null)
